completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-53-2002-MAINTENANCE-ORDER-RECIPROCAL-ENFORCEMENT-NOTIFICATION-2002.pdf》（1 页），本次切分 2 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Notification may be cited as the Maintenance Orders Reciprocal Enforcement Notification, 2002. ,. Designation.

The country and territory specified in the Schedule are hereby designated as a reciprocating country and territory respectively for the purposes of this Act as regards maintenance orders generally.

SCHEDULE

AUSTRALIA

HONGKONG SPECIAL ADMINISTRATIVE REGION OF THE PEOPLE'S REPUBLIC OF CHINA Dated this 11th. day of Rejab, 1423 Hijriah corresponding to the 18th. day of September, 2002.

DATO PADUKA AWANG HAJI KIFRAWI BIN

DATO PADUKA HAJI KIFLI

ATTORNEY GENERAL, BRUNEI DARUSSALAM.
